newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has rejected a proposal by Dhaka mayor for establishing Metropolitan Government for the capital city, saying such concept is found nowhere except in the Philippines.
Bangladesh's new president Shahabuddin Ahmed has vowed to uphold the constitution and advise both the government and the opposition to cooperate with each other in strengthening democracy.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia said the move to allow transit facility to India and buy electricity from there were part of a "deep-rooted" conspiracy against the sovereignty of Bangladesh.
The government will place a bill in the next session of parliament for repeal of the controversial Indemnity Ordinance that bars trial of the killers of independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

The Energy Ministry has proposed that commercial establishments, except medicine and food shops, be shuttered down after suset in view of widening gap between peak-hour demand and generation of electricity in the country.
